# `edit.subdivide`: Subdivide

Splits faces into quads at edge and face middles without moving anything (flat subdivision).

- Category: edit
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(4^levels x c log c) for the c corners of the selected faces, plus the selector
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups
- Also known as: subdivide, subdivide simple, polySmooth linear, tessellate, split faces

Every selected face is split into one quad per corner (quads into 4, triangles into 3, n-gons into n) through new vertices at the middle of each edge and face; the shape stays exactly the same. Unselected neighbours gain the new edge vertices so no cracks open. New faces keep their groups and are also `<label>.faces`; sharp edges and seams stay on both halves.

**Use for** more resolution before deforming (`deform.*`) or displacing, and for quad-only meshes from triangles. For smooth rounding use `subd.catmull_clark`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `levels` | `number` | `1` | Times to split (1 to 6); each level makes about 4 times as many faces. |
| `select` | `Selector \| null` | - | Faces to subdivide; every face when omitted. |
| `target` | `string` | required | Mesh object (name, path or id). |

## Examples

```json
{"select":{"faces":{"group":"front"}},"target":"crate"}
```

Result: `crate (o:1): subdivided 1 face into 4 (1 level); 4 neighbours gained corners; group subdivide_1.faces`
